title: Krabulous's Klient-Side Pack
description: The perfectly picked, profoundly playable, and personally pleasing client-side mods the latest versions have to offer! All hand selected, and updated by Krabulous himself.
body:
Krabulous's Klient-Side Pack is a combination of every client side QOL mod and performance mod for the best modern Minecraft gameplay experience. The whole pack is made to feel almost indistinguishable from vanilla, where you have to play for a while before you notice the changes. 

**Shaders** 

For shaders I went with Complimentary Re-Imagined, with the key setting of pixel shadows turned on. I think this simple change makes these shaders perfect for a vanilla-like experience(It also helps give a Vibrant Visuals vibe)

**Resource Packs**

I added a spattering of resource packs that change a lot of different aspects of the game in small ways. The C418 music pack is an espeically important one in my mind, as it keeps the game feeling like classic minecraft. I opted out for the all-too-popular Fresh Animations, as I feel like it veers too far off from the classic Minecraft feel. This pack is meant to be an enhancement of the vannila experience, not an entirely new game.

**Mods**

The mods I included are mostly performance and QOL mods, but I also wanted to make this a one-and-done pack, so I included a few helpful building mods(Axiom, World Edit, and Litematica). I didn't want any mods that would immeditaly give off a heavily-modded vibe, so most mods are under the hood.

Note: This pack uses vanilla tweaks. Credit:https://vanillatweaks.net/
